features.name: Autosave and crash recovery

portal_gun_spatial_pair.notes: Pressing F plays sound and reports a link; no paired portal construction/transport in this branch.

magnetic_boots_surface_walker.notes: Applies downward force; arbitrary-surface orientation and walking are not implemented in this branch.

slow_motion_dodge_roll.notes: Timed forward movement exists; no slow-motion time-control implementation in this branch.

visual_flow_graph.notes: Runtime branch only advances/resets a timer; graphData nodes and edges are not executed.

reflection_probe_cubemap.notes: Adjusts metalness/roughness once; this branch does not capture a cubemap reflection probe.

vehicle_suspension_physics.notes: Applies sinusoidal position bounce; wheel suspension/ground physics are not implemented in this branch.

procedural_chain_rope_physics.notes: Rotates the entity sinusoidally; this branch does not simulate linked rope/chain bodies.

consult_skill.notes: Reports a consultation without retrieving skill content or returning it to the model.

modify_entity.notes: Direct transform mutation bypasses command history and whole-prompt undo.

generate_script.notes: Registers code in the shared script library; source now persists, but full attachment/activation and isolation are not certified.

create_shader_graph.notes: Creates StandardMaterial properties; does not compile a node graph.

create_flow_graph.notes: Attaches graphData to a behavior whose runtime branch does not execute nodes or edges.

open_tool_modal.notes: Adds an executed result without opening a modal.

generate_sfx_preset.notes: Adds audio asset metadata without generated WAV data or an audio source.

set_hdri_skybox.notes: Selects an atmosphere preset; does not load or apply an HDR environment map.

add_sound.notes: Loads a real audio slot and awaits its resource report; full transactional rollback and acoustic/gameplay certification remain pending.

create_terrain.notes: Creates real undoable terrain with persistent final samples; requires graphics/physics systems rather than reporting a fallback box.

sculpt_terrain_heightmap.notes: Generates a new persistable terrain; this action is not an interactive brush edit of an existing terrain.

publish-modal.notes: Uses local preview and a publisher that generates a public-looking URL without uploading.

shader-graph-modal.notes: Graph canvas exists; applying uses sidebar material inputs rather than compiling graph semantics.

timeline.notes: Panel-local keyframe tracks are not included in current scene persistence.

ai-assistant.notes: Escaped chat and real actions exist; reliable complete-game workflow and transactional changes remain open.

flow-graph-modal.notes: Node/graph-data UI exists; attached runtime branch only advances a timer rather than executing graph logic.

topbar.notes: Portable project and asset-embedded HTML file actions supplement JSON save/recovery. File-menu HTML embeds pinned engine/physics; native installs and full gameplay delivery need certification.

assets.notes: Asset records and completed local-import bytes persist; imported labels render as text. Complete dependency packaging remains pending.

recovery-modal.notes: Text-rendered snapshot metadata with explicit restore/delete and focus handling; whole-project resource completeness and packaged crash recovery remain pending.

terrain-modal.notes: Real heightmap decoding feeds saved final samples; invalid dimensions/imports are reported. Full sculpting and physics/visual certification remain pending.
